metadata.title: test: improve test coverage massively from ~66% to ~80%
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Improve unit test coverage from ~66% to ~80%
- Fix incorrect variable reference in RPC handler: use `oauth_user_email` instead of `user_email` when forwarding requests to gateway service

Closes #2625

## Changes

**Bug fix:**
- `mcpgateway/main.py`: Correct email variable in `handle_rpc` gateway forwarding

**New test coverage (8,800+ lines added):**

| Area | Tests Added |
|------|-------------|
| **Cache** | Admin stats, auth L1/L2, cache invalidation subscriber, registry, session registry, tool lookup |
| **Middleware** | Token scoping |
| **Routers** | Email auth, LLM admin, LLM chat, log search, RBAC, SSO |
| **Services** | Audit trail, cancellation, gateway helpers, gRPC (no-grpc fallback), LLM proxy, MCP client chat, metrics rollup, OAuth PKCE |
| **Core** | Admin module, auth helpers, DB, schemas validation, toolops ALTK, translate gRPC |
